_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score-anchored Complacency plus muted funding and range-bound tape favor holding the rung until a clear flow or momentum breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative supplies bearish-leaning inflow color but no opposing phase call—weighted to analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound with F&G 45-55 and funding near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: sustained ETF-flow rebound with 30d momentum positive, or F&G under 40 with accelerating exchange inflows and range break
